statement: A negative result must describe absence of qualifying evidence rather than absence of every similarly named artifact. Issue #465 identified a certificate line saying no CODEOWNERS was detected even when a repository contained one outside the locations GitHub reads. The metric correctly withheld credit, but its copy overstated what the scan established. Rule: when evidence eligibility narrows, update both positive descriptions and negative outcome text, and assert the wording in the rendered certificate.

movesWhen.reason: The certificate negative-copy correction for Cejel issue #465 must land on main.
